items.title: RTX (RTX) Lands $22.9 Billion Tomahawk Deal With Seven Year Production Ramp
items.summary: RTX (NYSE:RTX) unit Raytheon has secured a US$22.9b Tomahawk cruise missile contract with the U.S. Navy spanning seven years. The agreement calls for a production ramp to more than 1,000 Tomahawk missiles per year and coordination with hundreds of suppliers. The contract is structured as a long term deal that provides visibility on Raytheon’s missile manufacturing pipeline for the Navy.
